data: Repeat grid commands and choose shortcuts that fit your Mac.

Record a sequence of grid commands. Save up to 12 fill, format and clear steps, then preview them on another range and apply them as one undoable edit. Record and Replay.

Choose your Notes and palette shortcuts. Open ⋯ → Keyboard Shortcuts to change the bindings for the command palette, Notes, pane focus and sending to Obsidian. Keyboard Shortcuts.
